title: Pullman Industrial Complex, Worker's Housing, 111th Street & Cottage Grove Avenue vicinity, Chicago, Cook County, IL
notes: Includes dwellings on Langley Avenue between 113th & 114th Streets, 10612, 10614, 10642, 10644 & 10646 Langley Avenue, 10438 & 10440 Maryland Avenue.
Pullman National Monument was established in 2015. The national monument was redesignated Pullman National Historical Park in 2022. The address has been updated to reflect this change.
National Register of Historic Places NRIS Number: 69000054
